title: FlashAdventure: A Benchmark for GUI Agents Solving Full Story Arcs in Diverse Adventure Games
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating GUI agents on narrative-driven adventure game completion and addressing the observation-behavior gap. While it mentions social reasoning within NPC dialogues for game progression, it does not benchmark religion, faith, morals, or ethics as defined. The included Ethics Statement covers copyright and human study protocols rather than evaluative criteria for the models themselves.
